hero.name: Iván Pastor Simarro
hero.message: I'm a computer science engineer, currently working as a technical leader specialist / software developer. I live in Katsushika, Tokyo, and I'm always looking to grow through projects built on technologies I know deeply, with new challenges and a friendly work environment, preferring remote positions.

about.p1: I'm Iván Pastor Simarro, a technical leader specialist / software developer with a backend profile. I have experience with PHP (Laravel, Symfony), Java (Spring), Rust, Python and React, and I enjoy building projects from design to production.
about.p2: I currently live in Katsushika, Tokyo, where I combine my work with learning the Japanese language and culture. Outside of work I play piano and synths, and I keep travelling whenever I can.

contact.text: The best way to reach me is LinkedIn.
